title: A replacement keeps its page address and Undo restores the original slug safely
steps: Run changeset generation and writer replacement cases.
expect: Only a matching WordPress slug in the same type and parent scope depends on its deletion.
Unconfirmed or conflicting deletion prevents creation; a failed create leaves the original available for Undo.
Undo restores the original slug, and preserves customer edits to either record.
Joomla alias replacement holds both records and dependents without mutations.

tests: WordPress: only a delete freeing the same page slug and parent precedes its replacement
Joomla: a replacement alias held by trash conflicts both records before the original is removed
a replacement waits for the confirmed delete, and Undo restores the exact original slug
a Joomla alias replacement held in preview never trashes the original or writes its dependents
